q_en:

A+ B means ‘A is the mother of B’
A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’
A x B means ‘A is the sister of B’
A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’
Based on the above, how is P related to Q if ‘P– M + N x Q’?
q_hi:
एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में,
A + B का अर्थ है कि 'A, B की माता है'
A – B का अर्थ है कि 'A, B का भाई है'
A x B का अर्थ है कि 'A, B की बहन है'
A ÷ B का अर्थ है कि 'A, B का पिता है'
उपरोक्त के आधार पर, यदि 'P– M + N x Q' है, तो P का Q से क्या संबंध है?

During a university outreach program, Nisha visited an industrial settlement where migrant workers and their families faced severe educational and social difficulties. While conducting interviews for her research, she met a local librarian who had independently established a small reading center for children using donated books and recycled materials. Unlike temporary institutional initiatives, the center functioned through voluntary participation and long-term community involvement. Influenced by the practical impact of the project, Nisha began assisting the librarian by organizing reading sessions, developing educational activities, and coordinating book collection campaigns within nearby colleges. Over time, she realized that intellectual achievement gained greater value when combined with direct social engagement capable of improving everyday conditions within marginalized communities. The experience ultimately transformed her understanding of academic success by convincing her that meaningful knowledge required sustained human involvement and practical contribution.

The rapid growth of artificial intelligence has transformed numerous sectors of modern society, including healthcare, education, transportation, and finance. Governments and private organizations increasingly depend on intelligent systems to improve efficiency, reduce operational costs, and enhance the accuracy of decision-making processes. In the medical field, AI-assisted diagnostic technologies help physicians identify diseases at earlier stages, while educational platforms employ adaptive software to provide individualized learning experiences for students with different abilities. Financial institutions similarly rely on predictive algorithms to detect fraudulent transactions and evaluate economic risks with greater precision. Consequently, many experts regard artificial intelligence as a powerful instrument capable of accelerating technological and economic development across the world.

Despite these advantages, the widespread expansion of artificial intelligence has generated serious ethical and social concerns. Critics argue that excessive dependence on automated systems may reduce human accountability and weaken employment opportunities in occupations traditionally performed by human workers. Furthermore, algorithmic systems are often shaped by the data used during their development, which may contain social or cultural biases. As a result, technologies such as facial recognition systems and automated recruitment platforms may unintentionally reinforce discrimination and inequality. Scholars therefore emphasize the necessity of transparent regulations that protect privacy, ensure accountability, and promote fairness in technological innovation. Ultimately, the debate surrounding artificial intelligence reflects society’s continuing attempt to balance technological progress with ethical responsibility in the digital age.

बीसवीं सदी में महात्मा गांधी के नेतृत्व में अहिंसा और सत्याग्रह के सिद्धांतों पर आधारित आंदोलनों ने स्वतंत्रता संग्राम को जन-जन तक पहुँचा दिया। असहयोग आंदोलन, सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन और भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन में लाखों भारतीयों ने भाग लिया। साथ ही, भगत सिंह, राजगुरु, सुखदेव, चंद्रशेखर आज़ाद और सुभाषचंद्र बोस जैसे क्रांतिकारियों ने बलिदान और साहस से आंदोलन को नई ऊर्जा दी।

इस संग्राम में किसानों, मजदूरों, महिलाओं, छात्रों और आदिवासियों की महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका रही। अनेक लोगों ने जेल यातनाएँ सहीं और अपने प्राणों का बलिदान दिया। अंततः लंबे संघर्ष और अपार त्याग के बाद 15 अगस्त 1947 को भारत स्वतंत्र हुआ। यह स्वतंत्रता संग्राम भारतीय एकता, साहस और दृढ़ संकल्प का प्रतीक है।
स्वतंत्रता संग्राम में वीरों की कुर्बानियों के कारण आज हम स्वतंत्र राष्ट्र में जीवन यापन कर रहे हैं। उनका बलिदान कभी भी भुलाया नहीं जा सकता।
